about: Plato's Chair, can you prompt it out of the Platonic chair? How varied Muse Image's doodles are under four prompts (default, any kind, an unusual kind, each of Muse Spark's listed kinds), against people's drawings (Google Quick, Draw!), visually (Meta DINOv2 spread) and in which KIND of object they show (Muse Glimmer multiple-choice labels). Derived statistics only; no drawings. See docs/plato.md.

Kind lists: Muse Spark 1.3 (Meta). Kind labels: Muse Glimmer 30B (Meta, open weights, self-hosted).

conditions.unusual: a chair (any kind of chair at all; pick an unusual or different kind) (tier 1 only)
conditions.listed: Muse Spark lists n_ai kinds; Muse Image draws each once
conditions.sdxl_*: Stable Diffusion XL, same prompts and seeds

spread: mean pairwise cosine distance within a concept
